They won. They are right, i am wrong. I dont know what im going to do. I dont want to go back to manual labor like before college. I was too feral even to be a technician, they didnt like me even when i was one of them. Im down to one friend thats already getting tired of my BS. I wish I could just make a living without interacting with people. There is no job that I can last at. I cant keep my stupid mouth shut, I tired.
